[/u][/size][/b]
[quote]
[size=3]I just uploaded the 1.5 compatible version, you can find them on the old files!
I'm sorry for not checking the comments regularly... 😭

Also, many of you asked me for [Stardew Valley Expanded] portraits and some of you wanted to commission me for the portraits too.
However I thought it would cost too much to an individual for all the portraits, so I decided to make it a Ko-fi goal.

This goal will help me work on the portraits more often in the time I do my other commissions.
So if you're interested, check out [url=https://ko-fi.com/leyalluna]my Ko-fi page![/url]﻿ Any support is appreciated! ✨

[size=5][b]How to Install[/b]
[/size]
[list=1]
[*]You need to have latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Extract [CP] Leyalluna's Portraits and Characters folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
